content.text:
You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Include the MODULE declaration, EXTENDS, CONSTANTS, VARIABLES, Init, Next and Spec. Include all safety invariants and liveness properties described, and any fairness conditions mentioned. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: This specification models a two-state process that alternates its control state between "A" and "B" while recording visits to state A in a history sequence. The initial state sets pc to "A" and starts with an empty history, action A moves to "B" and appends the current control state to history, and action B moves back to "A" while leaving history unchanged. The temporal specification requires initialization, allows stuttering via [][A \/ B]_vars, and adds weak fairness for the combined action A \/ B; it also defines a state constraint limiting the history length and a liveness property asserting that pc eventually becomes "Done", which is unreachable in the modeled behavior.
